notes: SHIP v1.14.440 - M2-b MERGE STEP 3b: THE PHASE CARD BUILDER COMES OUT, AND THE SURFACE GOES IN. WHAT 3b ACTUALLY WAS. The plan described a four-site extraction behind an onRefresh callback. Measured at .439 it is THIRTEEN sites, and a callback cannot reach nine of them because they run after the builder's scope is gone. .439 shipped the mechanism (phase_refreshSurface, a string key) and fixed the one site that was already live. This ship does the other twelve plus the lift. THE LIFT. The card loop was an IIFE inside deploy_showRackDetail that shadowed html to keep itself edit-free. It is now deploy_buildPhaseCards(deployId, rackId, rackPhases, rack, surface, opts) - a named builder with its own scope, so a second surface can ask for the same cards without re-entering the rack detail. Contract A2: one renderer, not a copy. VERIFIED FAITHFUL, NOT ASSUMED. The moved loop was diffed against its pre-lift original with indentation normalised: 73 lines both sides, and every single difference is one of the eight intended changes. No transcription damage. THE TWELVE SITES. Four onclick refreshes (OVERRIDE, START, BLOCK, UNBLOCK) now emit phase_refreshSurface with the caller's key. COMPLETE carries it into ge_onCompleteTap, which carries it into ge_openCaptureModal, which STORES it in _geCaptureState so ge_captureSkip and ge_captureSave land correctly after the modal closes. TROUBLESHOOT carries it into ta_open, which stores it in _ta_ctx for ta_resolveUnblock. The checklist strip carries it into checklist_addItem, checklist_removeItem, checklist_renameItem and checklist_toggleEdit. The stale badge carries it three hops - badge to deploy_openPhaseDriftModal to deploy_flagPhaseReverify. Every added parameter defaults to 'detail', so every pre-.440 caller is byte-identical. SECURITY OF THE KEY. surface is whitelisted to 'build' or 'detail' at every point where it is written into an onclick attribute, never interpolated raw. opts carries dep and rackAudit rather than re-deriving them - the detail already holds both and re-running deploy_loadAuditFor on a hot render path buys nothing; omitted, they load, so a new caller need not know what the cards read. CONTRACT 14. A builder with no resolvable deployment warns, toasts and returns empty rather than emitting five blank cards that would read as 'this rack has no phases'. WHAT IS NOT IN THIS SHIP, DELIBERATELY. Build does not yet MOUNT the cards. Where they live on Build is step 3c's question - the dock is what hosts them, and inventing an inline five-card scroll now would build something 3c deletes and put a composition in front of the owner that nobody chose. The 'build' key is not dead: ASSIGN has used it in production since .439, and the builder's build-surface markup is pinned by test. TESTS: new spec 28-phase-card-builder, nine tests. The builder and dispatcher resolve at page scope; every status branch still emits; the ungated START branch gets its own seed because a gated predecessor cannot produce it; ZERO surviving deploy_showRackDetail calls in the emitted markup for BOTH surfaces; each hop asserted by name; the stale badge chain asserted against a manufactured post-signoff audit event; _ta_ctx and _geCaptureState both proven to STORE the key; COMPLETE from Build lands on Build and reaches the detail zero times; and the rack detail still renders its cards. A TEST CORRECTION WORTH RECORDING. The branch-coverage test first failed on START against correct code. With an incomplete predecessor a PENDING phase renders GATED plus OVERRIDE, never START - deploy_isPhaseGated reads the stored phases, so the gate is a property of the SEED, not the builder. The markup was read before the test was changed, and START now has a seed that can actually produce it instead of an assertion against data that never could. RUNS (phone-webkit): 28 = 9 passed. 13 + 12 + 11 + 26 + 27 + 25 + 01 = 59 passed. GATES: 3 inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, 12 style blocks brace-balanced, 0 bare LF, three-stamp lockstep at .440. No CSS change, no renderer change - consolidation remains stopped per owner directive. DEVICE-VERIFY: open a rack detail and run one phase end to end - START, then COMPLETE, then the quirk modal's SKIP. PASS is the phase advancing and the rack detail refreshing exactly as it did before, with the phase dock still holding all five cards. FAIL is a control that does nothing, or a landing on a different screen.
